evidence_summary: Read end to end: Dave v3.0.0-alpha.7 released Tournament.sealLeafMatch/winLeafMatch, Match.sealDivergence/_requireAgreeState, Commitment.getRoot/toCycle, CartesiStateTransition.transitionState/_resolveInputWitness/_requireAccessLogProofFullyConsumed, DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput with LibBinaryMerkleTree.merkleRoot/LibKeccak256.hashBlock/LibMath.ceilLog2, and the regenerated-patched step (Buffer, AccessLogs, Memory, EmulatorCompat, UArchStep, UArchReset, SendCmioResponse, MetaStep). Compared with src/uarch-replay-state-access.hpp, src/replay-send-cmio-state-access.hpp, src/access-log.hpp make_proof, src/i-hasher.hpp get_merkle_tree_hash, src/send-cmio-response.cpp, src/uarch-step.cpp, and doc/recipes/prt-ethereum.lua append_log/encode/verify_transition and prt.lua validate_state_transition_response.

Buffer reads are unchecked (mload past data) but every peek is followed by consumption up to at least its end, so exact consumption in CartesiStateTransition rejects every read past data.length; peekRoot uses only the low nodesCount bits of the stride, and validateStrideLength bounds the stride below 2^nodesCount (no aliasing). Word accesses hash the full 32-byte leaf; region accesses take the node hash; the revert-root-hash read re-hashes the 32-byte value; TLB writes hash the packed little-endian slot exactly as shadow_tlb_fill_slot. unchecked blocks (readX/writeX index<<3 in uint8 with index<=31, uint64 add/sub helpers) match C++ wrapping; checked arithmetic (cycle+1, writeTlbECALL address, imcyclemax saturation) cannot overflow on accepted paths.

Experiment 1 (scratch fuzz.lua): 20,000 random uarch instructions (OP, OP-32, OP-IMM, OP-IMM-32, LUI/AUIPC, branches, JAL/JALR, loads, stores, ECALL halt/putchar/write-TLB with random indices, fully random words) with edge-valued registers: native log_step_uarch vs regenerated UArchStep (StepVerifier on the EVM harness anvil 8546, eth_call only). 0 mismatches in root or acceptance among the ~15,900 natively accepted steps.

Experiment 2 (cmio.lua, cmio2.lua): delivery lengths 0,1,7,8,31,32,33,63,64,65,100,4095-4097,65508,65535-65537,2^20+1,2^21-1,2^21,2^21+1 (no-op), mcycle near saturation (imcyclemax clamp), tohost manual/automatic with rejected/exception/0/7 reasons (no-op), Y=0 mid-run (no-op), revert root != before: EVM SendCmioResponse, C++ verify_send_cmio_response and the native machine all agree.

Experiment 3 (stf.lua): the released Dave CartesiStateTransition deployed bytecode run by eth_call with state overrides (no chain state change) and a mock provider returning the input Merkle root: input opening at counter 3<<68 with inputs of 324, 65536 and 1 bytes, opening without input (8-byte zero prefix), last counter 2^92-1 (step+reset) all agree with the emulator; a trailing byte and counter 2^92 are rejected.

Experiment 4 (gas.lua): eth_estimateGas on StepVerifier: delivery of a 65,536-byte input + first step, 28,448 bytes of logs: 1,637,223 gas; step+reset: 346,663 gas. Far below the EIP-7825 per-transaction cap of 2^24, before Dave's input Merkle root and tournament bookkeeping.

Checked and dismissed: DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput reading the current epoch's bounds (left open by the A3 hunter). A sealed inner match pauses both parent clocks (pauseForInnerAt), and winInnerTournament/eliminateInnerTournament need the child's innerResult, which needs _isFinished (closed and matchCount == 0). So no leaf match of an older epoch can still run when the next epoch is sealed.

Checked and dismissed: the native refusals of host-read-only (W must be cleared too, memory-address-range.cpp:49) and protected PMA ranges in machine::write_word are more sites of the pending R1-R3-1/R1-R10-1 (verifiers accept uarch stores the native uarch refuses). They are reachable only from a uarch that bypasses the interpreter's PMA checks, so no new candidate is reported.
not_covered: No live on-chain winLeafMatch through a deployed released Dave with a real InputBox input: CartesiStateTransition was exercised by state-override eth_call with a mock provider, so DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput / LibBinaryMerkleTree was checked only by reading, not executed against the emulator's data hash.
Gas of the full winLeafMatch transaction (Dave refund modifier, input Merkle root over 64 KiB, EIP-7623 calldata floor) was not measured; only the step-library part on the harness anvil.
Logs that the native uarch refuses as traps (all write_word refusals) were not crafted by hand and run through the EVM. Those sites are the pending R1-R3-1 class.

Differential fuzz covered single uarch instructions on synthetic uarch states; it did not run whole pristine-uarch mcycles of a Linux workload through the EVM step by step (only the harness smoke's 20 steps), nor reset with arbitrary iflags_Y/tohost/revert-hash leaf contents on the EVM.

Dave Match bisection (advanceMatch heights, requireChildren), Tree.Node leaf/inner-node domain separation and the clock/refund arithmetic of the leaf race were read only where they feed agreeState, divergencePosition and the counter.
MetaStep (pending R1-R11-1), the C++/Lua/JSON-RPC log decoders under ASan, and the referee model's own transport/decoding of player responses (prtu.lua, game-transport.lua) were not fuzzed.
The pure-regenerated (non-patched) step was not compiled. Results apply to regenerated-patched with TLB_NUM_SETS = 3.
